purpose: One setting on a settings page: its title, an optional description and a single control that saves on change, with no submit.

notFor.case: A form field that is sent with a Save or Submit button.
The heading of a group of settings.

Default.meaning: At rest; the control carries its own states.
Default.visual: Title in Content/primary (Type/label), description in Content/secondary (Type/body-sm), a bottom hairline in Border/subtle (Stroke/divider). Inline puts the control on the right, stacked under the text.

a11y.role: None of its own; the control in the Control slot carries the role.
a11y.keyboard: No keys of its own; the control keeps its own keyboard.
notes: The title names the control through aria-labelledby and the description describes it through aria-describedby.

openQuestions: Built Figma-first under exception STG-001 (governance/exceptions.yaml, review by 2026-12-02): the stories still need the owner's approval. Is the Figma set final for this intent?
There is no disabled row: when its control is disabled, should the title and description dim too?
It saves on change: where does a failed save show its error?
